name: ACD Admin Designer
author: steffen34ik

sections.description:
ACD Admin Designer lets you customize the WordPress admin interface with modern color schemes.

Create a cleaner, branded backend experience with just a few clicks. The plugin uses the native browser color picker, provides a live preview, and allows you to save your own default color scheme.

Features

  • Customize the admin bar, admin menu, buttons, hover states and focus colors
  • Live preview without saving
  • Save your own default color scheme
  • Restore your saved default anytime
  • Import and export color schemes as JSON
  • Ready-to-use preset designs included
  • Optimized for WooCommerce admin bar badges
  • Clean monochrome icon styling
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > ACD Admin Designer and customize your admin colors.
  4. Select the color scheme in your WordPress user profile if needed.
sections.faq:
Does this affect the frontend?

No. The plugin only changes the WordPress admin interface.

Can I restore my preferred design?

Yes. You can save your current colors as default and restore them anytime.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. It includes compatibility adjustments for WooCommerce admin bar badges.
